scope: The new component compares tool-level valuable-use-case inventories and pairwise outputs, whereas the existing execution Pareto analyzer computes pass-rate and resource-cost frontiers over matched candidate executions.
findings: The existing Pareto analyzer has no incumbent/successor tool identity or valuable-use-case coverage input.
The new analyzer does not aggregate repeated trials into a pass-rate frontier.
The output contracts are different and no same-task quality/cost trial compares these two analyzers; no replacement decision is made.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Assess whether a proposed tool covers all caller-declared incumbent use cases while preserving task-specific advantages, permission/risk deltas and explicit uncertainty.
next_low_cost_comparison: Reuse the same tool comparison dossier and check whether the Pareto output can satisfy the tool-scope disposition contract without losing use-case coverage or risk information; do not duplicate repeated-trial aggregation.
